criteria.description: Validate shipped static GLB, official format validation, scale/origin, exact geometry/texture budgets and provenance.

Check all recognition features: A broad tuft of smooth naked axes with exposed low horizontal basal H/K-like branches and upper forks, not foliage or fern fronds; Small flattened round-to-reniform sporangia on short upward lateral stalks, loosely spaced along upper axes rather than compact terminal spikes; Compact branched rhizome bears fine descending root-like axes without root hairs or caps; above-ground tuft approximately10cm tall/wide and roots approximately2cm. Respect claim scope: Conservative stylized whole-organism reconstruction concept of Zosterophyllum shengfengense based consistently on Hao2010 holotype PUH-QXI01-1 architecture. Source supports naked branching tuft, loose lateral sporangia and compact root-like system. Representative axis counts are reduced for512px legibility, not a census of the fossil; exact branch connectivity, depth, color and pose are artistic. No tissue anatomy or root caps/hairs asserted. Early Devonian association is supported, not an ecosystem reconstruction.

concept_decisions: Concept inspected: retain broad bowl-like branching tuft, naked axes and loose lateral capsules. Correct concept root overlength/spreading: root-like axes are about20mm below a compact10mm rhizome, not broad deep modern roots. Correct terminal-dominated concept: place most capsules laterally on short20-40degree stalks with naked axis extending beyond; do not cap every axis like Cooksonia. Flatten capsules, keep subtle reniform notch, no spherical berries or leaves. Approximately40-60 visible fertile axis ends,60-110 capsules and24-32 descending root-like axes are explicit low-poly reductions; source estimated many more. Preserve basal horizontal branching and upper forks. No soil disk.
intended_use: Static educational asset at256-512px; source world scale retained.
